outcome: Continuation lifetime is an operator decision and expiry degrades instead of detonating: the 24-hour retention becomes a manifest knob so multi-day releases stop aging out legitimately resumable state, and a continuation that expires mid-yield falls back to a labeled fresh rehydrate exactly as it already does at dispatch start - never a hard INVALID_CONTINUATION that burns the cycle.

exclude: continuation modes, the ledger, and replay correlation semantics (the vocabulary is settled; this slice changes lifetime governance and one failure path's grace)
degradation counting (posture-gated counting delivered in telemetry-foundations S4; an expired fallback on a context-retaining adapter still counts as real degradation)
the operational re-entry recipe (fresh-journal-per-revision remains an operator choice)

acceptance.text: Continuation retention is a manifest limit: maxContinuationLifetime (internal/driver/continuation.go:45, unexported compile-time 24h, stamped per-suspend at continuation.go:635) becomes an operator knob in manifest limits with a validated bound and the current value as default; the native session-root reaper (internal/driver/native_linux.go:882-886) follows the same governed value. Pinned by driver tests over expiry boundaries. Evidence basis: sworn#204 - multi-day releases age out legitimately resumable state by construction.

Mid-yield expiry degrades gracefully: when a retained continuation expires during the yield-resume loop, the cycle proceeds on a fresh rehydrate with the fallback_expired outcome labeled - today the start path degrades exactly this way (internal/runtime/dispatch.go:812-830 maps ContinuationStatusExpired to fallback_expired) while the yield-resume path hard-fails, because validRetainedContinuationMode rejects fresh_rehydrate and the default branch fires runtimeFail INVALID_CONTINUATION (internal/runtime/turn_recovery.go:1208-1234; the same asymmetry at :1257,:1274). The asymmetry dies: both paths degrade with the same labeled outcome. Pinned by turn-recovery tests over an expired-mid-yield fixture.

Every remaining INVALID_CONTINUATION site in the yield path carries its condition label (the site-label doctrine): the compound conditions at turn_recovery.go:1185 and the yield branch's default are distinguishable in the journaled failure, so a real contradiction is tellable from an expiry that should have degraded - pinned by tests asserting distinct labels per condition.

constraints: Honest absence stays honest: an expired continuation is a real context loss and its fallback_expired fact keeps feeding the degradation budget on context-retaining adapters - this slice softens the failure mode, never the signal.
The lifetime knob follows the manifest-limits pattern (validated bounds, default preserves today's behavior, new knob means new config-digest discipline at the operator's hand).

sworn#204's other arms are delivered or out of scope: fallback reasons land in event bodies and posture-gated counting shipped with telemetry-foundations S4; repair-dispatch continuity design remains future work and is not smuggled in here.
Check evidence belongs in the submission's checks field, never in files added to the repository.
